versionEvidence.esbuildHelperStatement: Conservative attribution for emitted __export/__commonJS-style helper boilerplate; the esbuild executable/tool package is not distributed with these fixtures.

evidenceMethod: Static TypeScript scanner/AST token comparison against exact integrity-verified registry module source. Only whitespace/comments, quote representation and const/let/var lowering are normalized; no identifiers or literal values are rewritten. Retained block/object/array/initializer anchors prove content agreement, not complete bundle reconstruction or a unique original installed patch version.
evidenceLimits: Module comment inventory and full small-file review identify eight inlined npm packages; esbuild generated-helper attribution is separate.
A package dependency declaration is not evidence that all its dependencies are inlined; dependencies without an emitted module are not mislabeled as shipped.

Retained-token anchors compare complete officially archived module source paths without executing their code. Tree-shaken modules may retain no matching anchor, and the complete original build was not reconstructed.
Historical build lock records exact versions but lacks resolved/integrity fields; new registry archive integrity verifies the retrieved artifact, not the old machine installation.
Zod additionally embeds an explicit 4.4.3 version object in all three applicable bundles. Other recorded versions are graded lock-and-code evidence, not cryptographic uniqueness claims.

Original standalone migration worktree source and author/package-level license fields are unavailable; local components retain the existing project source declaration without an invented external author or originality guarantee.
No private source history objects, private commit/PR references, absolute local paths, archive files, node_modules or audit operation logs are part of these public sidecars.
